verses.gurmukhi: ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਕਾਉ ਨ ਸੋਹਈ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗੁਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: van van kaau na sohiee kharaa siaanaa hoi vigutaa|

en.bdb: For crow wandering from forest to forest is no merit though it considers itself very clever.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੁਤੜਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕੁਮ੍ਹਾਰਾ ਕੁਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: chutaR miTee jis lagai jaanai khasam kumhaaraa kutaa|

en.bdb: Dog having mud spots on the buttocks is at once recognised as a potter's pet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾਣੀਆ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਕੁਪੁਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: baabaaneeaa kahaaneeaa ghar ghar beh beh karan kuputaa|

en.bdb: Unworthy sons tell everywhere about the feats of forefathers (but do nothing themselves).

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਗੂ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਹਾਇਦਾ ਸਾਥੁ ਛਡਿ ਚਉਰਾਹੇ ਸੁਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: aagoo hoi muhaidhaa saath chhadd chauraahe sutaa|

en.bdb: A leader who goes to sleep at the crossroads, gets his companions robbed (of their belongings).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮੀ ਸਾਖ ਉਜਾੜਦਾ ਗਲਿਆ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੀਹ ਕੁਰੁਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)mee saakh ujaaRadhaa galiaa setee meeh kurutaa|

en.bdb: Unseasonal rain and hail destroy the well rooted crop.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਖਟਰੁ ਬਲਦੁ ਜਿਵੈ ਹਲਿਜੁਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhukheeaa dhusaT dhubaajaraa khaTar baladh jivai halijutaa|

en.bdb: The suffering double talker is similar to a stubborn plaughing ox (who always gets whipped).
Ultimately such an ox is branded and abandoned in desolate places.
